disclosure: Chosen AFTER execution of the 1120-cell matrix and AFTER historical test outcomes were inspected. This is NOT prospective pre-registration. The original PROTOCOL_LOCK.json (frozen:false at submission) is preserved unchanged.

primary_panel.name: all_valid_strict
primary_panel.definition: all valid test windows under strict containment, drop_last=False at inference

sensitivity_panel.name: historical_crop
sensitivity_panel.definition: common historical crop using identical target populations for every compared model

rules: Keep cropped and all-valid windows separate
Never mix target rows/channels/leads within a declared panel
Deterministic fits are one effective run, not ten
Ten seeds estimate training variation, not independent epidemics
axis_order: (N_window, N_channel=7, N_lead=L)  -- TO BE VERIFIED against L and channel names

profiles.numeric_equivalence: measured max |diff| = 0.0 across the 7 aligned channels on 2026-11-04; byte hashes DIFFER

calendar: epiweek/date labels are synthetic; real CDC calendar and vintage NOT verified; no season-wise claim
